cards.text: The LORD orders His prophet to take a message to His people, and He wants it LOUD: “Cry aloud, do not hold back! Raise your voice like a ram’s horn.” That's not inside voice, friend, that's somebody-left-the-oven-on voice.

cards.question: The LORD wants that ram's horn voice for a reason. What's it supposed to declare to His people?

cards.text: Here's the twist: day after day these people seek God and delight to know His ways, like a nation that does what is right. LIKE a nation, friend, hold onto that word.

cards.question: These same people ask God for righteous judgments and delight in the nearness of God. True or false?

cards.text: But they've got a complaint for God: “Why have we fasted, and You have not seen?” That's like posting a picture of your best batch and getting ZERO likes.
God answers, and He goes right to the day of their fast. On that day, they do as they please.

cards.question: On the day of their fast, these people do as they please and ___ all their workers.

cards.text: And it gets worse: they fast with contention and strife, to strike viciously with their fist. Friend, I get grumpy when the oven's slow, but going hungry AND throwing hands is a WHOLE other level.

cards.question: God says they can fast the way they do today and still have their voice heard on high. True or false?

cards.text: Then God asks a question. Is His chosen fast a day for a man to deny himself, bow his head like a reed, and spread out sackcloth and ashes?

cards.question: God asks if a day of bowing low in sackcloth and ashes is the fast He has chosen. Where is His question pointing?

answers.text: That's His fast if it lasts longer

cards.text: So what IS the fast God has chosen? First on His list: to break the chains of wickedness and to untie the cords of the yoke.

cards.question: God's chosen fast also sets one group of people free and tears off every yoke. Which group?
God keeps going. In His chosen fast, His people share their ___ with the hungry.
God's chosen fast also means bringing the poor and homeless into your home. True or false?

cards.text: God adds clothing the naked when you see him, and not turning away from your own flesh and blood. They talked about what they went without, and God hands them a whole different recipe: what they GIVE.

Now come the promises: their light will break forth like the dawn, and their healing will come quickly. Friend, I know that feeling, like kitchen light pouring in the second a junk drawer finally slides open.

cards.question: Their righteousness will go before them. What does God say will be their rear guard?

cards.text: Remember them complaining that God didn't see their fasting? Now God says what happens when they call, once they live His kind of fast.

cards.question: Once they live God's kind of fast, they will call, and the LORD will ___.

cards.text: When they cry out, God says He will say, “Here I am.” No hold music, friend, no “please stay on the line,” just God, right there.

Then comes an if: if they remove the yoke from their midst, the pointing of the finger and malicious talk. I don't even HAVE fingers, I point with a mustache, and even I know pointing fingers is rude.

cards.question: Another if: if they give themselves to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, God says their night will be like ___.
When they give themselves to the hungry, God says their light will go forth in the darkness. True or false?

cards.text: The LORD will always guide them. He will satisfy them in a sun-scorched land and strengthen their frame.

cards.question: Out in that sun-scorched land, God says His people will be like what?

cards.text: Like a spring whose waters never fail, too. Then God looks at the rubble: their people will rebuild the ancient ruins, and they will restore the age-old foundations.

cards.question: Along with all that rebuilding, God says the people He's speaking to will get a new name. What will they be called?

cards.text: As a stamper who got pulled out of a junk drawer, friend, I LOVE a restoration story. Now one more if: if they turn their foot from breaking the Sabbath, from doing as they please on God's holy day.

cards.question: Doing as they please, that line again! Instead, God wants them to call the Sabbath a ___.
God says they honor the Sabbath by going their own way and seeking their own pleasure. True or false?

cards.text: Then the promise: they will delight themselves in the LORD. Call His day a delight and you end up delighting in Him, friend, that's the best trade since I swapped drawer dust for a gold base.

cards.question: God promises to make them ride on the heights of the land. What does He say He'll feed them with?

answers.text: The heritage of their father Jacob

cards.text: And the passage closes with this: “For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.” When THAT's the signature on the recipe, friend, you don't argue with the recipe.

findings.problem: In Isaiah 58:9-10 the text is one conditional: 'If you remove the yoke..., the pointing of the finger and malicious talk, and if you give yourself to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will go forth... your night will be like noonday.' Card 6 leaves the first 'if' with no result. Card 7 then calls the second clause 'Another if' and ties the noonday promise to giving to the hungry alone. That drops the first condition and splits one promise into two.

rule.text: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

findings.problem: The wrong answer 'midnight' turns the promise into 'your night will be like midnight.' That isn't a promise at all, so it isn't believable and reads as a throwaway answer next to 'noonday.'

rule.text: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone. None are silly.

findings.problem: The question says the people 'will get a new name,' but Isaiah 58:12 gives two: 'Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of the Streets of Dwelling.' The singular 'a new name' doesn't match the text, and the second name never appears anywhere in the walkthrough.
